item.title: github: Turn notifications into code with GitHub Copilot in Teams
item.description:
GitHub introduced a new GitHub app for Microsoft Teams that combines notifications with Copilot, letting teams act on issues and create fixes without leaving the conversation.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Email notifications for repository push events have been retired
item.description:
As of October 15, 2026, GitHub no longer sends email notifications for repository push events. The feature was retired to help prevent spam and abuse.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Custom thread subscriptions are being deprecated
item.description:
GitHub is deprecating custom thread subscription settings for notifications. Users will no longer be able to configure them, and support for existing custom thread subscription settings will be removed.

  • Source: GitHub
